pages.text: Slag is solidified waste of a metal. It remembers which metal it once was and is tinted in its color. Every slag layer contains 162 mB.

pages.title: Formation
pages.text: Slag forms when a pour onto a casting table or into a casting basin gets interrupted for too long. Right click the table or basin to take it out.$(br2)If the structure of a smelter breaks, everything inside instantly solidifies into slag layers which keep the order of the molten metals.

pages.title: Remelting
pages.text: Slag can be put into a smelter again. It melts into molten slag of its metal, so a flux like $(l:items/quartz_powder)quartz powder$() or $(l:items/calcite_powder)calcite powder$() is needed to recover the metal.$(br2)Slag layers of different metals can be stacked, eight layers turn into a slag block.
